The Houston Texans host the New York Giants in NFL week 7 regular-season play at Reliant Stadium. The Texans arrive with a 2-4 record to start the season, while the Giants arrive at 3-2-1 after losing, 34-27, to the New Orleans Saints.

The Detroit Lions host the Green Bay Packers in an NFC North matchup at Ford Field. Green Bay has won three straight games, beating Tampa Bay, Chicago and Dallas. Detroit relies on quarterback Jared Goff, who has 1,485 passing yards and 12 TDs.
